reviews.title: Lots of room for lots of drives.
reviews.comment: Great case. I have so far 14 drives installed which includes a 1.44 floppy drive and over 150Tb of storage. The case is roomy and makes it easy to plug things into the motherboard without drive and other peripheral interference..
reviews.author: Q Madp

reviews.title: The only case that can properly replace an old Antec 1200.
reviews.comment: The plentiful 5.25" bays are the driving feature of this case.  Plenty of space for large AMD Threadripper motherboards with decent cable management.  Fully loaded however can be a bit heavy to move but it looks to support wheel mounts on the bottom.  Supporting 240mm fans you can move a lot of air for excellent cooling.  The looks are modern and sharp.  This is the only case that can properly replace an old Antec 1200 and even the hexagon design works well reusing the Antec 1200 drive bays with the old fan speed control into this case looks 100 natural.  The build quality is excellent.
reviews.author: Amazon Customer

reviews.title: Penty of space to work with.
reviews.comment: It's incredibly massive and weighs a ton, that said... it's excellent.
reviews.author: Dan Turner

reviews.title: Big, somehow not big enough
reviews.comment: This is the biggest case I have ever used, somehow not big enough. To fit an Arctic Freeze III 420 in the top I had to remove the side panel for the 5.25 bays, it's too long and wide. This by itself kind of negates the point of this case, the 12 5.25 bays. I will be cutting the panel down, and designing a 3d printed top bracket to anchor the top. The main selling point is the 5.25 bays, I have a bunch of toolless bays for data recovery and migration. I really like that plethora of dust filters, top bottom and every drive bay has one. The power supply cover is a waste of space, was the first thing I pulled out.
reviews.author: Norm

reviews.title: Roomie lots of potential!!!!!!
reviews.comment: Build quality is excellent. It's a big PC case it needs to be to hold 12X 5.25 drives . Came with lots of screws and the metal is thick where it needs to be. Everything installed well and worked great. They even threw in some fans. I did not like the idea of having fans with lights on them but now watching the light show and them dance around it's kind of grown on me now. I watch a lot of movies and play a lot of disc based video games. I needed all this room for what I wanted to do. This thing looks really cool in my room with the lights out. It has two hard drive bays in the bottom of it, but don't let that discourage you with all the 5.25 Drive bays in the front you can easily put multiple hot swaps in the front. Anidees if you're reading this thanks for making an epic product. P.S please do not crucify me for my bad cable management.
reviews.author: Lyndon
